passive.name: Center of Attention
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **48/56/64/72/80%**. While the wearer is on the field, for every 1 Elation character in the team, increases the Skill Point upper limit by **1**, up to a max increase of **3**. For every 1 Skill Point the wearer consumes, enables the Elation DMG dealt by this unit to ignore **5/6/7/8/9%** of enemy targets' DEF, stacking up to **4** times. If **4** or more Skill Points are consumed in the same turn, the wearer gains "Stream Promo," which increases all allies' Elation by **20/24/28/32/36%**. Light Cone effects of the same type cannot stack.

passive.name: Decision
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **12/14/16/18/20%**. When the wearer uses an Elation Skill, increases Elation by **12/14/16/18/20%**, stacking up to **2** times.

passive.name: Decision
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **12/14/16/18/20%**. When the wearer uses an Elation Skill, increases Elation by **12/14/16/18/20%**, stacking up to **2** times.

passive.name: Rumble
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Elation by **12/14/16/18/20%**. When the wearer uses an Elation Skill, increases Elation DMG taken by all enemies by **6/7/8/9/10%** for **2** turn(s).

substatLine: ATK until 3600 (after team buffs) > CRIT Rate >= CRIT DMG
skillPriority: Elation Skill / Talent >>> Basic = Skill = Ultimate
tracePriority: Dazzling! Persona Kaleidoscope (A4) > Frenzy! Palette of Truth and Lies (A6) > Sweet! Punchline Signing (A2)

entries.name: Cat Got Your Flametongue?
entries.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to **100%** of Sparxie's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Bloom! Winner Takes All
entries.text: Finalizes the livestream. Deals Fire DMG equal to **100%** of Sparxie's ATK to one designated enemy, and Fire DMG equal to **50%** of Sparxie's ATK to adjacent targets.

entries.name: Boom! Sparxicle's Poppin'
entries.text: Start a livestream to turn Basic ATK into "Bloom! Winner Takes All" and trigger "Engagement Farming" 1 time. During this ability, "Engagement Farming" can be triggered repeatedly, up to **20** time(s). Using this ability is not considered as using a Skill.

entries.name: Engagement Farming
entries.text:
Causes "Bloom! Winner Takes All" to increase the DMG multiplier against one designated enemy by **20%** and the DMG multiplier against adjacent targets by **10%**. Randomly gains one of the following gifts:
"Straight Fire": **2** Punchline point(s) and **2** Skill point(s).
"Unreal Banger": **1** Punchline point(s).
Using this ability is not considered as using a Skill.

entries.name: Party's Wildin' and Camera's Rollin'
entries.text: Gains **2** Punchline point(s). Deals Fire DMG equal to (**0.6** × Elation + **50%**) of Sparxie's ATK to all enemies.

entries.name: Sleight of Sparx Hand
entries.text:
While Sparxie holds "Certified Banger":
Using Enhanced Basic ATK deals **40%** Fire Elation DMG to one designated enemy, and **20%** Fire Elation DMG to their adjacent targets. Additionally, for every 1 instance of "Engagement Farming" triggered, the Enhanced Basic ATK deals 1 extra instance of **20%** Fire Elation DMG to 1 random attacked enemy target.
Using Ultimate deals **48%** Fire Elation DMG to all enemies.

entries.name: Content Monetization
entries.text:
After using the Technique, inflicts enemies within a set area with "Block" for **10** second(s). "Blocked" enemies cannot detect ally targets.
After entering combat via actively attacking a "Blocked" enemy, deals Fire DMG to all enemies equal to **50%** of Sparxie's ATK and recovers **2** Skill Point(s) for allies.

entries.name: Signal Overflow: The Great Encore!
entries.text: Deals **50%** Fire Elation DMG to all enemies and deals **20** additional instance(s) of DMG. Each instance deals **25%** Fire Elation DMG to one random enemy. Grants **2** "Thrill" point(s) to Sparxie, which can be used to offset Sparxie's Skill Point consumption. Consuming "Thrill" is considered as consuming Skill Points.

entries.name: Sweet! Punchline Signing
entries.text: For every **100** of Sparxie's ATK that exceeds **2000**, increases this unit's Elation by **5%**, up to a maximum increase of **80%**.

entries.name: Dazzling! Persona Kaleidoscope
entries.text: When there are 1/2/≥3 Elation characters in the team, using Sparxie's Ultimate will additionally gain **2**/**4**/**8** Punchline and **1**/**1**/**4** "Thrill".

entries.name: Frenzy! Palette of Truth and Lies
entries.text: For every 1 Punchline currently owned, increases all allies' CRIT DMG by **8%**, up to a max increase of **80%**.

entries.name: #GoingViral #WhoIsShe
entries.text: When Aha Instant ends, gains 5 Punchline. For every 1 Punchline owned, increases All-Type RES PEN for all allies by 1.5%, up to a max increase of 15%.

entries.name: #AudienceKnows
entries.text: When Aha Instant ends, Sparxie gains 1 extra turn and 2 "Thrill." For every 1 "Thrill" consumed, increases this unit's CRIT DMG by 10%, lasting for 2 turn(s) and stacking up to 4 time(s).

entries.name: #LockedIn #FaceCard

Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: #BuiltDifferent #GoingExtinct
entries.text: Increases All-Type RES PEN by 20%. For every 1 Punchline taken into account, the number of additional DMG instances dealt by the Elation Skill increases by 1, up to a max of 40.
